jobs.scientific_question: Can the Phase A draft and proposal be converted into complete review queues and an auditable selection-freeze candidate without upgrading any scientific claim?
jobs.cheapest_credible_method: Use a standard-library deterministic builder over the merged Phase A JSON package; copy source-linked draft content into review packets, leave every reviewer field unfilled, and compute freeze gates mechanically.
jobs.expected_information_gain: Expose every review decision required for all 57 crosswalk rows and all 40 follow-on candidates, while proving that the 47-case panel remains a candidate rather than a frozen selection.
jobs.reusable_output: Versioned review queues, freeze candidate, readiness report, inheritance proof, schemas, builder, validator, and tests.
jobs.stop_condition: Stop if the builder would need to infer a reviewer decision, resolve a scientific conflict, alter a Phase A row, or mark the selection frozen.

jobs.scientific_question: Do identified human reviewers accept, revise, or leave unresolved the machine-draft crosswalk classifications, source mappings, and proposed panel dispositions?
jobs.cheapest_credible_method: Provide deterministic packets to identified reviewers and preserve signed or otherwise attributable submissions verbatim under the review-submission contract.
jobs.expected_information_gain: Convert machine-draft classifications and proposal dispositions into review evidence while retaining disagreements and unresolved fields.
jobs.reusable_output: Attributable per-row review submissions and an append-only attempt ledger.
jobs.stop_condition: Do not contact anyone or claim a review attempt until explicit outreach authority and reviewer identity are recorded; stop on missing evidence rather than filling fields for convenience.

jobs.scientific_question: Can exact source records for every frozen follow-on case be reacquired, rights-checked, content-hashed, and bound without inventing reaction, mechanism, site, or applicability claims?
jobs.cheapest_credible_method: After an explicit reviewed selection freeze, execute the per-case bounded source plan against authoritative resources and preserve source gaps and reference-only boundaries.
jobs.expected_information_gain: Determine which selected cases have sufficient source evidence for later compilation and which must abstain or fail closed.
jobs.reusable_output: A content-addressed source manifest suitable for a later compilation phase.
jobs.stop_condition: Do not acquire sources before the selection is reviewed and frozen and a bounded post-freeze budget is approved; stop on unclear rights, provenance, identifiers, or applicability.

claim_boundary: This ledger records planned or blocked jobs, not completed review, acquisition, or selection freeze.
Zero GPU work is authorized because the current bottlenecks are review, provenance, rights, and governance.
No outsider has been contacted and no reviewer has agreed to participate.
